name: QuantumFlex — Autonomous Lead Triage & AI Qualification

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ticket_id: $('Persist Ticket & Structured Ingress').first().json.ticket_id, worker_id: 'n8n-pipeline-worker' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: 'qwen2.5-coder:7b',
  prompt: 'You are a specialized intake assistant for a commercial mechanical contractor.
Analyze this raw inbound service request and extract structured triage facts.

Raw Request:
Client: ' + $('Persist Ticket & Structured Ingress').first().json.client_name + ' (' + $('Persist Ticket & Structured Ingress').first().json.location + ')
Contact: ' + $('Persist Ticket & Structured Ingress').first().json.client_phone + '
Message: ' + $('Inbound Lead Webhook').first().json.body.message + '

Output MUST be a single JSON object strictly matching this schema:
{
  "urgency": "CRITICAL" | "HIGH" | "STANDARD",
  "trade_category": "COMMERCIAL_REFRIGERATION" | "COMMERCIAL_HVAC" | "PLUMBING" | "GENERAL",
  "requires_urgent_review": boolean,
  "incident_summary": "1 to 2 factual sentences summarizing the reported equipment failure"
}
DO NOT include any estimated revenue or job values.
DO NOT promise arrival times or technician availability.
Return ONLY valid JSON. No explanations, no markdown fences.',
  format: 'json',
  stream: false
}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({
  ticket_id: $json.ticket_id,
  intake_status: $json.intake_status,
  urgency: $json.urgency,
  trade_category: $json.trade_category,
  requires_urgent_review: $json.requires_urgent_review,
  incident_summary: $json.incident_summary,
  dispatch_state: $json.dispatch_state,
  operator_alert_draft: $json.operator_alert_draft,
  error_reason: $json.error_reason
}) }}
